Flow Duration.label: Connection Duration
Flow Duration.tooltip: Total time elapsed from the first packet to the last packet in this network flow (an attacker could delay packets to manipulate this).

Total Fwd Packets.label: Total Outgoing Packets Sent
Total Fwd Packets.tooltip: Total count of individual packets sent by the client.

Total Backward Packets.label: Total Incoming Packets Received
Total Backward Packets.tooltip: Total count of individual response packets returned by the server.

Fwd Packets Length Total.label: Total Outgoing Data Volume
Fwd Packets Length Total.tooltip: Total sum of all payload bytes sent in the forward (client-to-server) direction.

Bwd Packets Length Total.label: Total Incoming Data Volume
Bwd Packets Length Total.tooltip: Total sum of all payload bytes received in the backward (server-to-client) direction.

Fwd Packet Length Max.label: Largest Outgoing Packet Size
Fwd Packet Length Max.tooltip: Maximum byte payload size among all outgoing packets sent by the client.

Fwd Packet Length Min.label: Smallest Outgoing Packet Size
Fwd Packet Length Min.tooltip: Minimum byte payload size among all outgoing packets sent by the client.

Fwd Packet Length Mean.label: Average Outgoing Packet Size
Fwd Packet Length Mean.tooltip: Average payload size in bytes for outgoing client packets (easily padded by attackers).

Fwd Packet Length Std.label: Outgoing Packet Size Variation
Fwd Packet Length Std.tooltip: Standard deviation in outgoing packet sizes — steady fixed-size packets vs. variable payloads.

Bwd Packet Length Max.label: Largest Server Response Packet
Bwd Packet Length Max.tooltip: Maximum byte payload size among all response packets returned by the server.

Bwd Packet Length Min.label: Smallest Server Response Packet
Bwd Packet Length Min.tooltip: Minimum byte payload size among all response packets returned by the server.

Bwd Packet Length Mean.label: Average Server Response Size
Bwd Packet Length Mean.tooltip: Average payload size in bytes for response packets returned by the server.

Bwd Packet Length Std.label: Server Response Size Variation
Bwd Packet Length Std.tooltip: Variation in byte sizes of server response packets.

Flow Bytes/s.label: Data Transfer Speed (Bytes/sec)
Flow Bytes/s.tooltip: Total byte transmission rate per second across the connection.

Flow Packets/s.label: Packet Transmission Rate (Pkts/sec)
Flow Packets/s.tooltip: Number of packets sent per second across the entire flow.

Flow IAT Mean.label: Average Pause Between Packets
Flow IAT Mean.tooltip: Average time elapsed between consecutive packets in the flow (manipulable by pacing traffic).

Flow IAT Std.label: Packet Timing Consistency
Flow IAT Std.tooltip: Variation in timing between packets — steady timing produces low variation while bursty traffic produces high variation.

Flow IAT Max.label: Longest Pause Between Packets
Flow IAT Max.tooltip: The single longest delay observed between any two packets in the entire flow.

Flow IAT Min.label: Shortest Pause Between Packets
Flow IAT Min.tooltip: The shortest delay recorded between any two consecutive packets in the flow.

Fwd IAT Total.label: Total Outgoing Packet Delays
Fwd IAT Total.tooltip: The combined time spent waiting between outgoing packets sent by the client.

Fwd IAT Mean.label: Average Outgoing Packet Pause
Fwd IAT Mean.tooltip: Average time elapsed between consecutive outgoing packets sent to the server.

Fwd IAT Std.label: Outgoing Packet Timing Variation
Fwd IAT Std.tooltip: How erratic or steady the delays are between outgoing client packets.

Fwd IAT Max.label: Longest Outgoing Packet Pause
Fwd IAT Max.tooltip: Maximum delay recorded between any two consecutive outgoing client packets.

Fwd IAT Min.label: Shortest Outgoing Packet Pause
Fwd IAT Min.tooltip: Minimum delay recorded between any two consecutive outgoing client packets.

Bwd IAT Total.label: Total Incoming Response Delays
Bwd IAT Total.tooltip: The combined time spent waiting between incoming response packets from the server.

Bwd IAT Mean.label: Average Incoming Response Pause
Bwd IAT Mean.tooltip: Average time elapsed between consecutive response packets arriving from the server.

Bwd IAT Std.label: Incoming Response Timing Variation
Bwd IAT Std.tooltip: How much the delays between server response packets fluctuate.

Bwd IAT Max.label: Longest Incoming Response Pause
Bwd IAT Max.tooltip: Maximum delay recorded between any two consecutive server response packets.

Bwd IAT Min.label: Shortest Incoming Response Pause
Bwd IAT Min.tooltip: Minimum delay recorded between any two consecutive server response packets.

Fwd PSH Flags.label: Client Push Flag Counter (Frozen)
Fwd PSH Flags.tooltip: Structural counter for TCP Push flags sent by the client.

Fwd URG Flags.label: Client Urgent Flag Counter (Frozen)
Fwd URG Flags.tooltip: Structural counter for TCP Urgent flags sent by the client.

Fwd Header Length.label: Client TCP/IP Header Length (Frozen)
Fwd Header Length.tooltip: A structural protocol header size in bytes — fixed by the TCP/IP stack; cannot be arbitrarily changed without corrupting the connection.

Bwd Header Length.label: Server TCP/IP Header Length (Frozen)
Bwd Header Length.tooltip: A structural protocol header size for server responses — fixed by protocol standards.

Fwd Packets/s.label: Outgoing Packet Rate (Pkts/sec)
Fwd Packets/s.tooltip: Rate of outgoing packets transmitted by the client per second.

Bwd Packets/s.label: Incoming Packet Rate (Pkts/sec)
Bwd Packets/s.tooltip: Rate of incoming response packets received from the server per second.

Packet Length Min.label: Overall Smallest Packet Size
Packet Length Min.tooltip: Minimum packet size observed across both flow directions.

Packet Length Max.label: Overall Largest Packet Size
Packet Length Max.tooltip: Maximum packet size observed across both flow directions.

Packet Length Mean.label: Overall Average Packet Size
Packet Length Mean.tooltip: Average packet length in bytes across the entire bidirectional flow.

Packet Length Std.label: Overall Packet Size Variation
Packet Length Std.tooltip: Spread of packet sizes across the entire connection.

Packet Length Variance.label: Packet Size Variance
Packet Length Variance.tooltip: Statistical variance in packet lengths throughout the connection.

FIN Flag Count.label: FIN Termination Flag (Frozen)
FIN Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Finished flag indicating graceful connection teardown — closing the connection.

SYN Flag Count.label: SYN Handshake Flag (Frozen)
SYN Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Synchronize flag used strictly during connection establishment — cannot be modified on an active session.

RST Flag Count.label: RST Connection Reset Flag (Frozen)
RST Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Reset flag indicating immediate connection abort.

PSH Flag Count.label: PSH Push Data Flag (Frozen)
PSH Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Push flag requesting immediate buffer delivery to the application.

ACK Flag Count.label: ACK Acknowledgment Flag (Frozen)
ACK Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Acknowledgment flag indicating received data packets — mandatory for stateful communication.

URG Flag Count.label: URG Urgent Data Flag (Frozen)
URG Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Urgent flag indicating high-priority out-of-band data.

CWE Flag Count.label: CWE Congestion Window Flag (Frozen)
CWE Flag Count.tooltip: TCP Congestion Window Reduced flag defined by RFC 3168.

ECE Flag Count.label: ECE Explicit Congestion Flag (Frozen)
ECE Flag Count.tooltip: TCP ECN-Echo flag indicating network router congestion notifications.

Down/Up Ratio.label: Download vs Upload Ratio
Down/Up Ratio.tooltip: Ratio of received (downstream) packets to sent (upstream) packets.

Avg Packet Size.label: Mean Flow Packet Size
Avg Packet Size.tooltip: Average size of individual packets transmitted during the session.

Avg Fwd Segment Size.label: Average Outgoing Segment Size
Avg Fwd Segment Size.tooltip: Mean TCP segment size for forward packets sent by the client.

Avg Bwd Segment Size.label: Average Incoming Segment Size
Avg Bwd Segment Size.tooltip: Mean TCP segment size for response packets sent by the server.

Subflow Fwd Packets.label: Subflow Outgoing Packet Count
Subflow Fwd Packets.tooltip: Count of forward packets belonging to individual flow sub-sequences.

Subflow Fwd Bytes.label: Subflow Outgoing Byte Volume
Subflow Fwd Bytes.tooltip: Total forward byte volume in individual flow sub-sequences.

Subflow Bwd Packets.label: Subflow Incoming Packet Count
Subflow Bwd Packets.tooltip: Count of response packets belonging to individual flow sub-sequences.

Subflow Bwd Bytes.label: Subflow Incoming Byte Volume
Subflow Bwd Bytes.tooltip: Total response byte volume in individual flow sub-sequences.

Init Fwd Win Bytes.label: Initial Client Window Size (Frozen)
Init Fwd Win Bytes.tooltip: Initial TCP receive window size negotiated at connection handshake — a protocol-level invariant.

Init Bwd Win Bytes.label: Initial Server Window Size (Frozen)
Init Bwd Win Bytes.tooltip: Initial TCP receive window size set by the server during handshake — a protocol-level invariant.

Fwd Act Data Packets.label: Outgoing Packets with Data Payload
Fwd Act Data Packets.tooltip: Number of outgoing forward packets that contain at least 1 byte of actual application data payload.

Fwd Seg Size Min.label: Minimum Outgoing TCP Segment Size
Fwd Seg Size Min.tooltip: Minimum TCP segment size observed for outgoing client packets.

Active Mean.label: Average Active Connection Period
Active Mean.tooltip: Average duration the flow was actively transmitting data between idle periods.

Active Std.label: Active Period Consistency
Active Std.tooltip: Variation in the duration of active transmission periods.

Active Max.label: Longest Active Transmission Period
Active Max.tooltip: Maximum time spent actively transmitting data before pausing.

Active Min.label: Shortest Active Transmission Period
Active Min.tooltip: Minimum time spent actively transmitting data between pauses.

Idle Mean.label: Average Idle Silence Duration
Idle Mean.tooltip: Average time the connection sat completely quiet with zero packet transmissions.

Idle Std.label: Idle Duration Variation
Idle Std.tooltip: Variation in how long the connection remained silent between bursts.

Idle Max.label: Longest Idle Silence Period
Idle Max.tooltip: Maximum duration of complete silence on the network connection.

Idle Min.label: Shortest Idle Silence Period
Idle Min.tooltip: Minimum duration of complete silence between data bursts.

Protocol_0.label: Protocol: HOPOPT (Frozen)
Protocol_0.tooltip: IPv6 Hop-by-Hop Option indicator — fixed structural protocol classification.

Protocol_6.label: Protocol: TCP (Frozen)
Protocol_6.tooltip: Transmission Control Protocol indicator — fixed structural protocol classification.

Protocol_17.label: Protocol: UDP (Frozen)
Protocol_17.tooltip: User Datagram Protocol indicator — fixed structural protocol classification.
